newsitem.title: UK: Labour heading for UK landslide - poll.
newsitem.headline: Labour heading for UK landslide - poll.

text.p: The opposition Labour Party is heading for a landslide victory in Thursday's election, according to the latest opinion poll.
Labour, out of power since 1979, has now taken a 22-point lead over the ruling Conservatives, the latest Gallup poll for the Tuesday edition of the Daily Telegraph showed.

Labour, which has moved to the political centre under reforming modernist Tony Blair, had 51 percent of voter support compared to 29 for the Conservatives and 13 percent for the minority Liberal Democrats.
If the poll proved correct on election day, this would translate into a 265-seat majority for Labour in the 659-seat parliament.
